CytoSig

1. Preparing CytoSig input for RUN module:
- The expression values, from either RNASeq or MicroArray, should be transformed by log2(x+1). 
- x could be FPKM, RPKM, or TPM for RNASeq. 
- For single-cell RNASeq data, used log2(TPM/10 + 1). 
- Recommeded to input differential profiles between the two conditions. 
- If data is from a sample collection without pairs, do mean-centralize the value of each gene across all samples.

2. Preparing CytoSig RUN module:
- Log in to https://cytosig.ccr.cancer.gov/
- Choose RUN module
- Upload the input file (CytoSig_input_Endothelial_meancentered.txt) and click "Run"


# CytoSig on endothelial subcluster
```{r}
# Load Seurat object: Stromal_endothelial 
load("/cluster/projects/aokigroup/t138390uhn/scRNAseq_ALCL_FFPE/data/Seurat_objects/subclustering_2603/Stromal_endothelial_subclustering_res0.1.Rdata")

# Check column names of metadata
colnames(stromal_endothelial@meta.data)

# Remove stromal clusters, keep only endothelial and LEC
endothelial <- subset(stromal_endothelial, subset = stromal_endothelial_celltype == "endothelial" | stromal_endothelial_celltype == "LEC")

table(endothelial$stromal_endothelial_celltype) 
# endothelial         LEC
#        1562         878 

# Output dir
out_dir_cytosig <- "/cluster/home/t138390uhn/scRNAseq_ALCL_FFPE/figures/CytoSig/"
dir.create(out_dir_cytosig, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# ============================================================================ #
# Normalization for CytoSig
# Formula: log2(TPM/10 + 1)
# ============================================================================ #

normalize_cytosig <- function(counts_mat) {
  # Step 1: TPM normalization
  # TPM = (counts / gene_length) — but for scRNA-seq without gene lengths
  # TPM is approximated as CPM (counts per million) since we don't have gene lengths
  tpm <- sweep(counts_mat, 2, colSums(counts_mat), "/") * 1e6

  # Step 2: log2(TPM/10 + 1) (CytoSig formula)
  log2_tpm <- log2(tpm / 10 + 1)

  return(log2_tpm)
}

# Aggregate per patient
pb_pos <- AggregateExpression(
  endothelial,
  group.by = "stromal_endothelial_celltype",
  assays   = "RNA",
  slot     = "counts"
)$RNA
pb_pos <- as.matrix(pb_pos)

# Normalize: log2(TPM/10 + 1) — CytoSig formula
tpm_pos          <- sweep(pb_pos, 2, colSums(pb_pos), "/") * 1e6
cytosig_pos      <- log2(tpm_pos / 10 + 1)

nrow(cytosig_pos)  
ncol(cytosig_pos) 
#[1] 18518
# [1] 2

# check:
cat("Any NA:", anyNA(cytosig_pos), "\n")
cat("Any Inf:", any(is.infinite(cytosig_pos)), "\n")
cat("Expression range:", round(range(cytosig_pos), 3), "\n")
## Expected: Min = 0, Max ~ 10-15
# Any NA: FALSE 
# Any Inf: FALSE 
# Expression range: 0 9.338 


# Save
cytosig_pos_df <- as.data.frame(cytosig_pos) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Gene")

write.table(
  cytosig_pos_df,
  file      = file.path(out_dir_cytosig, "CytoSig_input_Endothelial_pseudobulk.txt"),
  sep       = "\t",
  quote     = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================================ #
# Mean Centralization
# Required because endothelial subcluster has no paired condition
# ============================================================================ #

row_means      <- rowMeans(cytosig_pos)
cytosig_pos_mc <- cytosig_pos - row_means

round(range(cytosig_pos_mc), 3)
# [1] -3.891  3.891

# Should be centered around 0
# output:
# Mean-centralized range: -3.891  3.891
# Min: -3.891  <- genes expressed BELOW average across patients
# Max:  3.891  <- genes expressed ABOVE average across patients
# meaning Centered around 0

cytosig_pos_mc_df <- as.data.frame(cytosig_pos_mc) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Gene")

write.table(
  cytosig_pos_mc_df,
  file      = file.path(out_dir_cytosig, "CytoSig_input_Endothelial_meancentered.txt"),
  sep       = "\t",
  quote     = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
